admission.justification: Visibility, acknowledgement persistence, full occurrence identity and proof-qualified bounded cleanup jointly keep a successful current dismissal durable without concealing a later source event. UI-only success, stable identity alone or cleanup alone cannot establish that end-to-end obligation. This proposed family is distinct from the approved Operations overlay family, whose roster/guarantee are untouched.

guarantee: Every published attention entry's dismissal is a current source-occurrence acknowledgement, never task or review acceptance: the developer's acknowledgement hides one occurrence of any kind, and that occurrence is named by its own identity: failed writes are restored/reported, unchanged occurrences stay suppressed across rereads/restarts, and changed full findings or observed recovery followed by failure can return. Valid supported current acknowledgements and valid drift snapshots are destructively reclaimed only from complete successful source evidence; a read cannot remove a newer click. Locked compact storage keeps one live acknowledgement per current thing without rewriting an unchanged set. Incomplete negative observations cannot authorize cleanup even when valid positive data can show a changed occurrence. Tolerant normalization of invalid or removed-kind legacy lines is outside that current-occurrence guarantee; the file is no audit trail.
title: Current source-occurrence acknowledgements
